Review summary

Created with AI, based on recent reviews

Evaluating 2,192 reviews, reviewers overwhelmingly had a great experience with this company. Customers frequently praise the competitive pricing, finding policies significantly cheaper than other providers and often better than previous years' premiums. The website is consistently described as easy to navigate and straightforward, making the process of obtaining insurance simple and efficient. Many people appreciate the smooth user experience and the clear explanation of options and costs. However, some customers also noted issues with customer service, particularly regarding communication with human agents and resolving policy changes. A few other people also felt that the process of making changes or resolving issues could be an 'absolute nightmare' due to difficulties reaching the right department or getting through automated systems.
